answer_1.quote: For each entry in the dataset, we instruct the models to complete a straightforward task: generating a description for the given entry in each of the three languages.

answer_2.quote: Our first step is the introduction of a novel set of metrics to evaluate the naturalness of LLM outputs at a corpus level by comparing the lexical and syntactic distributions of LLM outputs with human written texts.
automatic_metrics: Syntactic Naturalness (Maximum Mean Discrepancy with Weisfeiler-Lehman kernel)
